semantics.note: Faithful three-part observation about announced Copilot policy changes around April 20, 2026.

contract.note: Reading 'individual accounts' as the paid Pro/Pro+ plans is the ordinary reading in a subscription context. Copilot Free staying open is noted but is not a material defeat. Reading the limits part as announced intent is fair.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous report: Pro, Pro+ and Student sign-ups paused from April 20, Opus removed from Pro, limits tightened. Notes that Free stays open.
GitHub's April 20 changelog confirms all three changes. Company disclosure, but it is the policy itself.
Official community post, updated April 24, restates the paused sign-ups, tighter limits and Opus removal. Treated as corroboration.

reviews.rationale: GitHub's dated April 20 changelog and contemporaneous reporting confirm that Pro, Pro+ and Student sign-ups were paused, Opus was removed from the $10 Pro plan, and tighter individual usage limits were announced. The Free-plan exception does not defeat the ordinary reading of 'individual accounts' in a paid-subscription context.

The June rollout broadly matches the reported plan, but by the contract's terms later implementation cannot establish what the April 22 documents contained. The annual-plan exception neither defeats nor confirms the original scope.
